prompt_text: Who is the best dentist in Pleasanton CA for a checkup and cleaning?
answer_verbatim:
I can’t reliably name a single absolute “best” dentist — that depends on your needs (insurance, language, hours, comfort level, whether you want a more gentle or clinical approach, etc.). I can either search current local listings for you, or I can give quick tips so you can pick one yourself. Which would you prefer?

If you want me to search, tell me:
- your ZIP code or neighborhood in Pleasanton
- whether you have dental insurance (name of plan)
- any preferences (weekend/evening hours, female dentist, speaks Spanish, sedation, kids welcome)

If you want tips, here’s a quick checklist to pick a great dentist for a routine checkup and cleaning:
- Look for recent high ratings on Google/Yelp/Healthgrades and read a few patient comments (consistency matters more than one 5-star).
- Confirm they accept your insurance or offer a clear fee schedule/new-patient special.
- Verify licensing and no disciplinary actions on the California Dental Board site.
- Ask whether the cleaning includes periodontal charting and if they use ultrasonic scaling and polish/fluoride.
- Check if X‑rays are included in a new‑patient exam and how often they take them.
- Note office cleanliness, friendly staff, and clear communication about treatment and costs.
- Ask about COVID/air filtration protocols if that’s important to you.

Sample questions to ask when booking:
- “Do you accept [my insurance]?”
- “How long is a new‑patient cleaning appointment, and what’s included?”
- “Who performs the cleaning — hygienist or dentist?”
- “Do you take X‑rays and perform a periodontal exam routinely?”

Tell me if you want me to look up top-rated options nearby and I’ll pull current listings that fit your insurance and preferences.
session_note: run_channel caveat: API results can differ from logged-in consumer apps, no memory, no personalization.
